DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: Ilwww.dilg.com.ph OILG OPINION NO. 75 NOV 20 HON. ARNOLD V. VERANO Acting Vice Mayor Narra Municipal Hall 7C83+XWQ, Narra Avenue Narra, Palawan Dear Hon. Verano This has reference to your letter dated July 3, 2023 requesting the Department to give you the authority to create and fill-up positions whether regular, contractual or casual, and the power to appoint employees for the position. It must be recalled that the Department issued a Designation Order dated June 27 2023 in your favor as Acting Vice Mayor of the Municipality of Narra, Province of Palawan due to the suspension for six (6) months of the incumbent Mayor, Hon Gerandy B. Danao in a case docketed as OMB-L-1-A-21-0044, entitled. "Citinikel Mines & Development Corporation vs. Gerandy B. Danao", which was implemented by the DILG Provincial Office on June 6, 2023 Item V(l) of DILG Memorandum Circular provided limitations on the power of the designated officials, to wit: V. POWERS OF THE DESIGNATED OFFICIAL'S 1. The designated officials shall exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local government position concerned as provided by law, except making or participating in any decision related to the following: 1.1 Appointment, suspension or dismissal of local government officials and employees, except as those allowed under the Local Government of 1991 and other laws; 1.2 Creation and filling-up of positions whether regular, contractual or casual; xxx "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No: 8876-34-54

It is for this reason that you requested the Department to authorize you to: (1) create and fill-up positions whether regular, contractual or casual; and (2) to appoint employees for the position as recommended by the Commission on Audit in its Audit Observations Memorandum At the outset, Section 46 of the LGC provides that. Section 46. Temporary Vacancy in the Office of the Local Chief Executive. - (a) When the governor. city or municipal mayor, or punong barangay is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties for physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office, the vice- governor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking sangguniang barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. (Emphasis ours) The scope of your power necessarily includes the power to appoint, suspend or dismiss all officials and employees of the Sangguniang Bayan, which is applicable herein as the vacancy exceeds thirty (30) daysl However, as to your request that you be authorized to create positions, DILG Legal Opinion No. 56, s 2019? is enlightening, thus' It is the Sanggunian that has the authority to create position and it is the Vice Mayor who has the authority to hire employees and approve voucher and disbursements of funds pertaining to expenses of the Sangguniang Bayan. Sections 443(c)(2), 447(a)(1)(viii) and 445(a)(2) of the Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 state. Section 443. Officials of the Municipal Government. xxx (c) The sangguniang bayan may: (I) Maintain existing offices not mentioned in subsections (a) and (b) hereof; (2) Create such other offices as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of the municipal government; or (3) Consolidate the functions of any office with those of another in the interest of efficiency and economy. DILG Opinion No. 27, s. 2019 dated June 18, 2019 Dated September 10, 2019 Page 2 of a

Xxx ARTICLE Ill The Sangguniang Bayan Section 447. Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensation. — Xxx (1) Approve ordinances and pass resolutions necessary for an efficient and effective municipal government, and in this connection shall: (viii) Determine the positions and salaries, wages, allowances and other emoluments and benefits of officials and employees paid wholly or mainly from municipal funds and provide for expenditures necessary for the proper conduct of programs. projects, services, and activities of the municipal government, xxx Section 445. Powers, Duties and Compensation. (a) The vice-mayor shall: (1) Be the presiding officer of the sangguniang bayan and sign all warrants drawn on the municipal treasury for all expenditures appropriated for the operation of the sangguniang bayam (2) Subject to civil service law, rules and regulations, appoint all officials and employees of the sangguniang bayan, except those whose manner of appointment is specifically provided in this Code; (3) Assume the office of the municipal mayor for the unexpired term of the latter in the event of permanent vacancy as provided for in Section 44, Book I of this Code; (4) Exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the municipal mayor in cases of temporary vacancy as provided for in Section 46, Book I of this Code: and (5) Exercise such other powers and perform such other duties and functions as may be prescribed by law or ordinance. Accordingly, it is the Sanggunian that has the authority to create position and it is the Vice Mayor who has the authority to appoint officials and employees. The opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and/or the courts. Page 3 of 4

We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you Very truly yours, ORITY OF THE SECRETARY. UAN ICTOR R.
